claims.text: The hotel occupies the reimagined former Austrian Monarchy Bank building.

findings.quote: the Golden Quarter hotel occupies the reimagined 1915 Austrian Monarchy Bank
findings.note: editorial states hotel occupies reimagined Austrian Monarchy Bank

claims.text: The building is a sandstone structure with columns and carved embellishments.

findings.quote: an imposing sandstone structure with columns and carved embellishments

claims.text: The Golden Quarter luxury shopping district is only steps away from the hotel.

findings.quote: Shop in the most luxurious boutiques at the exclusive Golden Quarter (Goldenes Quartier), only steps away from the hotel

claims.text: Every room features elements of wood, marble and mother-of-pearl.

findings.quote: Elements of wood, marble and mother-of-pearl welcome you in every room.

claims.text: Bathrooms are marble, with a separate bathtub and rain shower and heated floors.

findings.quote: Relax in a spacious marble bathroom with separate bathtub and rain shower, heated floors and exclusive amenities.

claims.text: The Bank Brasserie has an open show kitchen where diners can watch the chefs at work.

findings.quote: The open show kitchen allows diners to watch and follow the chefs preparing delicious menus using high-quality products.
findings.note: stated in The Bank Brasserie & Bar section

claims.text: Cafe Am Hof offers cakes, chocolates and tartes made by the team of Chef Patissier Oliver Ivanschits.

findings.quote: The display is filled with delicious cakes, chocolates and tartes lovingly prepared by the team around Chef Patissier Oliver Ivanschits.
findings.note: stated in Cafe Am Hof section

claims.text: The Rossano Ferretti Hairspa is located in the hotel's former Living Room.

findings.quote: The Rossano Ferretti Hairspa is located at the former Living Room of Park Hyatt Vienna

claims.text: Dogs receive a Very Important Dog service with treats on arrival, a dog bed and a dog bowl.

findings.quote: we offer our Very Important Dog service, which includes dog treats upon arrival, a comfortable dog bed for the night and a dog bowl.

claims.text: The Arany Spa is set in the building's former vault, and gold-bar-shaped tiles line its swimming pool.

findings.quote: the former vault has been transformed into the Arany Spa, where gold-bar-shaped tiles line the nearly 50-foot-long swimming pool.

claims.text: The Bank Brasserie & Bar is housed in the former central cashier hall.

findings.quote: The central cashier hall now houses the Bank Brasserie & Bar

claims.text: Wall decorations are inspired by brooches designed by Art Nouveau artist Carl Otto Czeschka.

findings.quote: maximalist wall decorations inspired by blown-up brooches originally designed by Art Nouveau artist Carl Otto Czeschka

claims.text: From May to October, the outdoor terrace becomes the Bollicafe, run in collaboration with Champagne Bollinger.

findings.quote: From May to October, the elegant outdoor terrace of Park Hyatt Vienna transforms into the Bollicafé in collaboration with Champagne Bollinger

claims.text: The Grand Salon ballroom is where bank directors of the Laenderbank once conducted negotiations.

findings.quote: this ballroom is bursting with history. Where once bank directors of the Länderbank conducted negotiations, today all types of events can be held within this historic space.

claims.text: Self-parking is in the public Am Hof car park in front of the hotel, which has a height restriction of 2.05 metres.

findings.quote: Guests can use the public car park (Am Hof) in front of the hotel for self-parking.
The car park has a height restriction of 2.05 metres.

claims.text: The weekend brunch at The Bank Brasserie is not available in July and August.

findings.quote: Experience a delightful weekend at our luxurious brunch at The Bank Brasserie.
findings.note: weekend brunch at The Bank Brasserie

findings.quote: Not available in July and August.

claims.text: Children under 16 can use the spa only when accompanied by an adult, from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m.

findings.quote: Children under the age of 16 are welcome when accompanied by an adult from 11 a.m.–6 p.m. daily.
findings.note: stated in Arany Spa / wellbeing section
